items.title: Rockets expose Pacers’ defensive flaws in another home loss
items.body_excerpt: The Rockets swallowed Ivica Zubac. (Photo: DAZN) The Pacers were back at Gainbridge Fieldhouse on Wednesday, closing out a home-friendly stretch in which they played three of their last four games on their court. In came the Houston Rockets, looking to respond after a loss in…
